home.faq1Q: Does it cost anything for my customers?

home.faq2Q: Is TimeFlow certified for ID06 / compliance?
home.faq2A: Yes, we support full integration with ID06 for digital personnel registers according to statutory requirements.
home.faq3Q: Which accounting systems do you support?
home.faq3A: Through our AutoEconomy integration (add-on), we connect with leading accounting systems on the market. Contact us for the full list.
home.faq4A: Yes, tax deductions are handled automatically on invoice documents for private customers.

about.heroDesc: TimeFlow is built for the trade and construction industry — an all-in-one platform covering everything from quotes to booked invoices. Today, the system is used by over 4,000 trade companies.
about.missionP1: The trade industry loses billions every year due to administrative burden, duplicated work, and lost receipts. We believe technology should make your work simpler — not more complex.
about.missionP2: Thats why we built a platform that works equally well for solo contractors and large construction firms. Equally seamless for electricians, plumbers, and cleaning contractors. A unified ecosystem where mobile workers, office staff, and customers communicate effortlessly.
about.val1D: Every feature is tested by real tradespeople in the field before release. If it doesnt work with work gloves on a busy job site, we dont release it.
about.val2D: No hidden fees. Minimum contract commitment is only 3 months. You pay for what you use — nothing more.
about.val3D: Our support team speaks your language and understands your industry. You talk to an expert, not a ticket number.
about.val4D: Our product roadmap is driven by customer feedback. Over 60% of new features stem directly from user requests.
about.tl1D: The vision was born — creating a platform covering every aspect of a trade business.
about.tl2D: First digital personnel register went live with major construction enterprises.
about.tl3D: Launched TimeFlow Home — connecting homeowners and contractors in a unified workflow.
about.tl4D: Introduced the industry first AI assistant trained on building regulations and compliance.
about.tl5D: Expanding across Norway, Denmark, Finland, Germany, and broader European markets.
about.moreDesc: Get in touch — wed love to discuss your business and how TimeFlow can streamline your operations.

cases.heroSub: How trade businesses use TimeFlow — and how we compare against legacy software solutions.
cases.case1Headline: Halved office admin time — without hiring additional staff.
cases.case1Body: Before TimeFlow, two full-time employees spent most of their week on timesheets and invoice preparation. Today, that work runs automatically.
cases.case1Quote: We were skeptical about yet another system. After two weeks, nobody wanted to go back.
cases.case2Headline: Tax deductions in 30 seconds instead of 30 minutes.
cases.case2Body: Field technicians clock in with GPS, materials are scanned on site, and invoices with correct tax lines are generated automatically via AutoEconomy.
cases.case2Quote: We now invoice the same day the job is completed. Before, it took a week at best.
cases.case3Headline: The entire service fleet in a single view.
cases.case3Body: With digital scheduling, the dispatcher sees where all vehicles are located, what inventory is on board, and which technician is closest.
cases.case3Quote: TimeFlow has become our command center. Calls are down, workflow is seamless.
cases.compareSub: Other software solutions only solve individual pieces. TimeFlow PRO delivers the complete end-to-end chain — from leads to booked invoices, KMA, contracts, forecasting, and executive dashboards.
cases.disclaimer: Comparison based on publicly available information as of Jan 2026.
cases.tengellaSub: Tengella is an established ERP system for cleaning and service providers. The platform relies on a core module set combined with third-party integrations.
cases.vsHeader: What TimeFlow provides that Tengella lacks
